_comment: The record tools/precedent_decommission.py writes when a fully deprecated
path is deleted, and the list of files whose references to a deleted path
are historical record rather than a live pointer.
exempt_files: philosophy/README.md is the index for philosophy/, and
index-remembers-past puts a document's lineage there rather than in either
document. Recording that OPEN_QUESTIONS.md was folded into ASSORTED_NOTES.md
means naming it, permanently -- that is the entry doing its job, not a

decommissioned.reason: its five items were folded into philosophy/ASSORTED_NOTES.md's closing Open Questions section on 2026-09-09; a five-item list is a section, not a document

this project's own voice is now a repo-local practice, templates/local-practices/project-voice.md.template, instantiated at local/practices/project-voice.md instead of a root document -- see that template's own header
